notes.problem: Faceless mannequin from behind, laptop lost in shadow, empty caliche left 40 percent.
notes.fix: Three-quarter front camera at tailgate height so the screen-lit face and hands fill the middle half; bed and case into the foreground.

notes.problem: Mannequin operator from behind, red seam artifact, black slab laptop, feet cropped, half the frame empty pink plane; the review act is a few pixels.
notes.fix: Camera low three-quarters over the right shoulder so the map fills about a quarter with the finger on one rim turning filled; crop the empty ground and lower body.

notes.problem: Smooth mannequin operator from behind, flat pink caliche plane fills the left half, no lit face or leaning pole.
notes.fix: Low three-quarter front camera with the face lit from the open laptop, push in so operator and tailgate fill the lower two thirds, pole and cobalt dusk behind.

notes.problem: With the hand removed the plate floats above its slot; strata read as a comb; dek on a dark blob.
notes.fix: Seat the pulled plate in its slot raised a hand's height against the end plate with contact; rake the key along the edges; type on the plain wall.

notes.problem: No lift; the plate stands proud of the rack with a flat decal face; 265 plates merge into a striped band.
notes.fix: Raise the plate clear of a visibly empty slot with a shadow; bevelled bright top edges with navy gaps.

notes.problem: The 265-plate rack becomes striped noise in front of an electric blue wall; the lifted plate is a flat texture.
notes.fix: Rake the camera so plate edges catch the window as strata, model the lifted plate in relief, warm the wall toward honey.

notes.problem: Roof reads as hovering with no wall under the eave, straight cylinder limb, dark plate behind the type.
notes.fix: Walls and contact under the eave visible, a barked limb with crown, a lower oblique so lawn and street give the type quiet.

notes.problem: Thin stick limb, two chrome spheres on the roof, empty lower left lawn, near-solid navy wash over the top 40 percent.
notes.fix: Thick tapering limb with a pale break across the ridge, spheres as turbine vents, camera dropped and pushed about 15 percent.

notes.problem: Route stops abruptly mid street with a rounded cap; dek covers the upper half.
notes.fix: Curve the route onto a near driveway or off the bottom edge so it arrives somewhere; lower the camera so near roofs fill the bottom third.

notes.problem: Straight glowing route ending mid street; dek over a broad violet wash.
notes.fix: Gentle S bend flat on the asphalt with warm spill, taper to a thread, tighten the dek seat.

notes.problem: The 24 markers read as a white fence, the peach band on the last six does not show, the metaphor needs the dek.
notes.fix: Run the markers toward the camera so they repeat like a ruler and give the last six a clearly different lit cap.

notes.problem: Route runs under the worker's feet and never bends around the obstruction; blob root plate; a curb bar dominates the bottom centre.
notes.fix: Delete the curb bar and lay the ribbon from the bumper in one clear right curve around the canopy tip and out the right edge, arm along it.

notes.problem: The stitched plane reads as a green grid; the seam is not the focal point.
notes.fix: Push onto the seam so loose plates cast long shadows onto the plane at centre; crop the empty top margin.
